items.text: Not much optimism DeVonta Smith will play Sunday vs Rams; sidelined with hamstring this week, expectation he won’t go. Rams get back Puka Nacua.
items.why: Missed practices this week after playing through it last week; sources indicate won't play.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth tested vs Rams; Nacua returns as WR1.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Eagles secondary options.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury; will miss at least 4 games.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 3; coach confirmed IR.
items.implication: Misses at least next 4 games including bye opportunity later.

items.text: Rams expect Puka Nacua back for Week 4 vs Eagles after hip/groin issues; McVay and OC indicate full practice progress and expected to play.
items.why: Full/limited practices progressing; coach expectation confirmed.
items.implication: Elite WR1 returns; reduces Adams/Higbee standalone.

items.text: Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers among those upgraded to full practice participants Thursday.
items.why: Upgraded from limited/DNP prior day; minor issues.
items.implication: Both expected to play vs Titans as top options.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/routes restored; Flowers efficiency high on limited prior snaps.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): led all RBs with 90% snap rate last week, 20 of 22 RB touches with Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ yards to RB every game. Top 10 play.
items.why: Workhorse usage on short week; favorable matchup and Dowdle OUT.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% target share and 104 ypg career with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return last week. NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Elite connection/usage with Penix back; soft WR matchup.

items.text: Fresh ROS rankings: Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall notable near top; also Parker Washington 22, Saquon 30, Matthew Golden 40. Prefer JT side in Flowers+Montgomery for JT trade.
items.why: Updated for injuries/roles/schedule if season started today; Walker elite.

items.text: Waiver/injury: Travis Etienne = Alvin Kamara, Kendre Miller beneficiaries; also Achane season-ending ACL opens Ollie Gordon etc. Detailed injury report for waivers.
items.why: IR/season-ending create clear backfield opportunities; snaps post-injury noted.
items.implication: Priority adds/starts for Kamara/Miller; Gordon stash.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO: just 16% target share and 34 rec ypg career with Penix; under 8 FP in 9 of 13 such games; TE37 utilization this year.
items.why: Historically poor production/opportunity with Penix; low aDOT/targets.
items.opportunity: Low targets none inside 10; underperforms even available looks.
items.conflict: Some may still start on name; usage disagrees.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 utilization, 3.5% target share, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42% W3, 13% third downs; SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: Mitchell likely out again; 36% target share last without him; 78% catch rate, 9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ YPR.
items.why: Elevated target share without Mitchell; efficient vs soft secondary.

items.text: LOVE Josh Downs vs WSH: 31% target share last two, 43% red-zone looks; WSH allows most FP and TDs to WRs/slot.
10 Facts: Warren 90% snaps/20 of 22 touches; Love 26 touches (more than W1+2), 78% rushes, util 91 (RB5); post-Etienne Kamara 50% snaps, Miller 30%, Donaldson 23% (committee expected).
items.implication: Start Warren/Love; Kamara flex but committee.

items.text: Kyle Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT; among worst results relative to actual opportunity so far.
items.why: Low volume quality and efficiency vs opportunity chart.
